header: scripts/harvest-cpi.ts: loads the Consumer Price Index of MoSPI into the database (public.cpi_month): the new series (base 2024) from January 2026 to the latest month due, every State and sector, and the old series (base 2012) of all India from 2016 to December 2025, which gives the inflation chart its ten years. It makes about 20 requests to MoSPI's open service (no login, no key), one after the other. The card does this by itself the first time and tops up a missing month later; I run this script to put the data there beforehand, or to re-read everything (rows are replaced, nothing is duplicated). npx tsx --env-file=.env.local scripts/harvest-cpi.ts load everything npx tsx --env-file=.env.local scripts/harvest-cpi.ts list what is saved
